implementation_notes: The provided text is an official news article (China Meteorological News Press, updated 2025-04-29) summarizing the joint departmental regulation 'Measures for Artificial Intelligence (AI) Meteorological Application Services' promulgated by CMA and CAC on 2025-04-23 and effective 2025-06-01. Because this source is a press release overview rather than the enacted statutory text itself, binding_strength and document_type are coded as regulatory_guidance rather than binding_law. The summary states that the Measures adopt classified and graded supervision and establish systems for algorithm registration and security assessments, labeling of AI-generated synthetic content, algorithm safety review, cybersecurity, data security, information dissemination review, and complaint reporting, alongside collaborative governance with enterprises, universities, and research institutions.
